DSH Set Relations — compact proper-set symbols derived from KaTeX 0.16.47

Copyright (c) 2009-2010 Design Science, Inc.
Copyright (c) 2014-2018 Khan Academy.
Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.txt.
Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.16.47
Sources: dist/fonts/KaTeX_AMS-Regular.woff2 and KaTeX_Main-Regular.woff2

The renamed font contains U+2ACB and U+2ACC. The containment curves are
20% flatter with their TeX widths and 40-unit rules preserved.
The two lower bars retain their original weight with a 60-unit gap;
the shorter diagonal remains 40 units thick. Both signs use an upward
slant for negation. The complete signs are raised 233 units to align their
vertical centers with uppercase set letters. No entire-glyph scaling is
applied. Font revision and name records identify version 1.2.

Rebuild with fontTools and Brotli from the UI package directory:

python third-party/katex/build-relations.py node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/KaTeX_AMS-Regular.woff2 node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/KaTeX_Main-Regular.woff2 src/client/fonts/DSHSetRelations-Regular.woff2

The KaTeX and MathLive patches carry matching layout metrics. Word
exports retain native editable U+2ACB/U+2ACC mathematical characters;
the Office application's mathematical font determines their outlines.
